column5: READ LIVE 2026-09-21 with get_design_context on the fragment whole (5446:82429), get_metadata on its 768 [12166:455681] and 375 [12166:455730] siblings, and get_metadata on the purchased 1440 page [5443-69253] that mounts it. Every number the wave-59 row left open is now read and built. Right half: a flat 32 inset around a 68 column, so 32+22+10+8+10+18+32 = 132, the fragment's height. Title 'Course progress' is Lg/Paragraph 1 300, Manrope 16/22 at -0.64 [5446:82435] where the page ran 14/18: now lg:text-[16px] lg:leading-[22px] lg:tracking-[-0.64px]. Completion row Mulish 14/18 [5446:82444] where it ran 16: now lg:leading-[18px]. Outer corners 24 (rounded-3xl on both halves' outer edges) where it ran 12: lg:rounded-[24px]; the fragment's drop shadow 0 4 12 at 24% black: lg:shadow. No stroke anywhere on the fragment, so no 1px to pay. The readout is CTA/button [5446:82446] 119x18: ONE text run '100% complete' (100% white, complete Ash) and a 16px icons/action on a 10 gap, the eight-ray loader glyph filled Ash #95A09F (md5 ebcefd02 on the export), drawn as the library's Loader. It is the same composition on all three boards - 115x16 at 768 and at 375, and 89+10+16 = 115 - so the glyph and the 10 gap land at every width, where the page drew a 4-gap pair with no glyph. MEASURED ON THE PAGE, NOT THE FRAGMENT: the purchased 1440 board draws NO 367 rail - its banner Frame 632 [5443:71001] spans the whole 1318 column as two 659 halves, 32 under the title row - and the page drew the rail for every loaded course, which would have squeezed an owned course's banner to about 761. The rail is now drawn only for an unowned course. SOURCE: fill, sentence and percent are one fact, and CourseEntitlement already carries it as progressPercent (number | Offline); the banner ignored it and hardcoded Offline. It now reads it: while Offline the track is drawn empty and data-unavailable with its reason, the sentence says progress is not recorded, and the readout draws the dash, never a zero; with a figure the fill and readout follow it and the frame's completed sentence is drawn only at 100. The 20 days long pair is opacity 0 on the node and keeps its slot showing nothing. REACHABILITY, stated plainly: the banner mounts only for an OWNED course and getEntitlement returns Offline in production, so no viewer reaches it until an entitlement source lands; the page draws its access-cannot-be-confirmed panel instead. The mount is asserted through the page with an owned entitlement in src/pages/learn/__tests__/courseProgressBanner.figma.test.tsx (6 tests, which count every child of the column and the readout); courseDetailsCard and learnRoutesMount stay green (6 and 10). Scoped tsc over both files: no error in either. Commits fa199cabd and f2133f443 on superproject main, NOT pushed (lane rule) and NOT deployed (Ruling 16). Lead for whoever holds 5443-69253, not built here: that board's in-progress banner writes 'You're almost there!' then 'Keep it up.' on a 4 gap [5443:71041-71042] over a 479-of-595 fill, its tabs row sits 32 below the banner, and the page's owned body runs a 24 seam.

READ LIVE 2026-09-21 with get_design_context on the whole fragment 5460:87886, and on its before-playing sibling 11342:142483 to settle which chrome governs: both carry the SAME card, so neither is an ALT of the other. THE PAGE'S CARD WAS WRONG AT 1440 on four counts the wave-56 metadata read could not see: the card is Green Coal 200 #122524, not #001615; it has NO stroke, where the page drew a 1px #123F3C hairline; its radius is 16 (rounded-2xl), not 24; and its padding is 16/16/64, not a flat 16. Column on a flat 14: 16 + 571 + 14 + 34 + 14 + 0 + 14 + 264 + 64 = 991, the frame's reported height, so the rule (5460:87897, a zero-height vector stroked 1px #123F3C) is UNCOUNTED and the pixel CSS spends on it comes out of the 14 under it - lg:mt-[13px] - decided on that edge child and not on a centred one. BUILT at lg: lg:border-0 lg:bg-[#122524] lg:pb-16 at radius 16; stage Row 2 16:9 at radius 4 (rounded, was 8) on both the stage and its unavailable panel. Nav 1015x34 on a 16 gap: Video transcript Manrope 18/24 -0.72 in Gray 100 #E0E0E0 (was white); Skai AI powered Manrope 14/18 -0.56 Sky Blue (was 12/16) and flex-1, which is why its box is 202 wide; the hidden Icons/Screengrab is not drawn. Hide transcript 145x34: 16/8 padding, 14/18 label, a 16 minus glyph (export is a 1..15 bar) on an 8 gap and a 1.5 #123F3C outline drawn INSIDE, since 8+18+8 = 34 is the whole box, so CSS pays lg:px-[14.5px] lg:py-[6.5px] + 1.5. Summarize video 162x34: Sky Blue on 16/4 padding, a 24 glyph box and the label 14/18 Green Coal on a 4 gap, stretched to 34; the logos/others export is the component's DEFAULT image (a fox) and not what renders, and the render is a single four-point star, so the glyph is now Sparkle, not the three-mark Sparkles (768 and 375 not screenshot-checked; the same instance is used there). Transcript Frame 902 726x264: a 48 time column in Mulish 16/16 -0.64 Ash, a 14 gutter, a 664 measure in Manrope 16/22 -0.64 Wind #E2F2EC, and an empty 22 line between every paragraph within and between cues; built as lg:text-[16px] lg:leading-[22px] lg:max-w-[664px] lg:gap-[22px] with the reached colour lg:text-[#e2f2ec]. SOURCE: no media host and no transcript store, so the stage draws its unavailable panel and the transcript draws its own on the frame's 726x264 box (lg:!min-h-[264px] beats the panel's inline 180); Summarize stays inert. NOT RE-DECIDED: the control bar the page keeps inside the stage comes from board 5446-85963 (wave 56), and the card's 1047 width inside a 1318 page column is the page board's, not this fragment's - the app column is the ruled 1144. Witness src/pages/learn/__tests__/courseVideoFrame.figma.test.tsx, 5 tests that count the card's four children and the Summarize button's two; learnRoutesMount 10 green; scoped tsc clean in both files. Commit 96b7cb79b on superproject main, NOT pushed, NOT deployed.
